integrity_note: The quantitative bound and equality profile follow from an analytic argument; finite numerical checks are supplementary and do not certify an infinite assertion. Literature uniqueness cannot be certified from search alone.
scientific_limitations: Only an integrable integer-valued distribution with log-concave survival, the mass at the next integer at least the positive mass at the threshold, and a mean at least that threshold. Does not classify all adjacent-mass ratios or arbitrary real laws. Older reliability work might contain equivalent bounds.
title: A sharp adjacent-mass-one bound for discrete increasing-failure-rate tails
